Subject: VDB Swarm: strategy sync + vendor gating for Pinecone/Weaviate/S3 integrations

Team + partners —

We kicked off a cross-vendor project (internal name: VDB Swarm) to enable dynamic routing between Pinecone/Weaviate and our S3-backed cold store for customers who need latency-cost blending. Before we open a pilot with ACME Corp, we need a short partner gating pass that covers:

- security/compliance checklist (data handling, encryption in transit/rest, audit logs)
- performance envelope (99th p99 latency targets for <4k token context)
- operational hooks we need in our control plane (metric names, backpressure signals, error codes)
- onboarding artifacts (demo scripts, sample datasets, migration job template)
- rollback/fallback behavior and time-to-failover SLOs

I've attached a first-draft gating criteria spreadsheet and demo scripts. Maria/Sam — can you confirm who on your side will own the gating questions and whether you have existing docs we can reference? ACME consulting, please flag any additional procurement/contracting gates we should include.

Proposed timeline: 2-week gating pass starting Dec 6, pilot kickoff week of Dec 20. If that's too aggressive, say so and suggest dates.

Thanks — Kala (Karthik)
Karthik Iyer
Head, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: vdb-swarm-gating-criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet), demo-scripts.md (text)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VDB Swarm: strategy sync + vendor gating for Pinecone/Weaviate/S3 integrations

Karthik —

Agree with the list. A few notes from an ops perspective:

- For performance we should include steady-state QPS profiles plus a 30-minute ramp test; p99 is fine but add a p50 baseline for cost modeling.
- For the control plane hooks, we need a health check API and a tokens-used webhook for accounting (we want deterministic token billing splits for the pilot).
- Migration job: include an option to run a dry-run that only computes vector diffs; that will be critical for ACME's compliance team.

I'll pair with Marissa to update the gating sheet and add example curl commands to demo-scripts.md.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partner Solutions — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Hi Karthik / team —

Thanks for the clear list. Maria here — happy to lead Pinecone's side. Quick answers: 

- Security: we already have a SOC2 report and per-tenant encryption; I'll attach our compliance packet (see pinecone-sla-draft.pdf). For the gating sheet, our security lead asks for an example retention policy and the expected egress patterns (to validate DLP).
- Performance: Pinecone can meet p99 < 45ms for typical 2k-dim embeddings at our standard config. We'll run the 30-minute ramp test Vanessa requested and provide telemetry.
- Control hooks: we expose a /health and a metrics endpoint (Prometheus). We can add a light-weight token-usage webhook within the pilot window.

I'll schedule a 30-minute tech sync for Dec 7 with our SRE and docs owner.

Maria Gonzales
Partnerships, Pinecone
maria@pinecone.io

Subject: Re: VDB Swarm: strategy sync + vendor gating for Pinecone/Weaviate/S3 integrations

Thanks all — good progress. I'm attaching a filled gating checklist (sheet tab: "v0-gate-pass") and a compact mutual action plan in the Drive link. Key action items I captured: 

1) Pinecone (Maria) to share final compliance packet and confirmed telemetry names by EOD Dec 9.
2) Weaviate (Sam) to confirm support for our token-usage webhook and provide an estimated timeline for the ramp test (target Dec 14).
3) Redwood (Vanessa/Marissa) to produce demo-scripts.md updates and a migration dry-run job template by Dec 13.
4) ACME consulting to confirm procurement lead and any SOW redlines by Dec 15.

Risks/notes: ACME expects a contractual clause that limits background indexing to non-production windows; include that in the procurement checklist. Also capturing a fallback SLA: if a vendor misses p99 target by >2x during the pilot, we want automatic routing to S3 cold reads and a post-mortem within 48 hours.

Please review my gating sheet and comment inline. If nobody objects, we'll treat the Dec 20 pilot kickoff as tentative pending gate pass.

Marissa Cole
